mapper.sql: select c.id, c.order_id, c.order_item_id, c.order_no, o.order_type, c.goods_id, c.goods_name, c.user_id, c.user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, c.supplier_id, c.score, c.content, c.images_json, c.reply_content, c.reply_time, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, c.del_flag from xfpt_comment c left join xfpt_order_info o on c.order_id = o.id left join sys_user u on c.user_id = u.user_id and u.del_flag = '0'

select c.id, c.order_id, c.order_item_id, c.order_no, o.order_type, o.school_id, o.school_name, c.goods_id, c.goods_name, c.user_id, c.user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, c.supplier_id, c.score, c.content, c.images_json, c.reply_content, c.reply_time, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, c.del_flag, (select count(1) from xfpt_comment_reply r where r.comment_id = c.id and r.del_flag = 0) as reply_count from xfpt_comment c left join xfpt_order_info o on c.order_id = o.id left join sys_user u on c.user_id = u.user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select c.id, c.order_id, c.order_item_id, c.order_no, c.goods_id, c.goods_name, c.user_id, c.user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, c.supplier_id, c.score, c.content, c.images_json, c.reply_content, c.reply_time, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, c.del_flag from xfpt_comment c left join sys_user u on c.user_id = u.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' where c.id = #{id}

select r.id, r.comment_id, r.order_id, r.order_item_id, r.goods_id, r.supplier_id, r.from_user_id, r.from_user_name, from_u.avatar as from_user_avatar, r.from_role_type, r.from_role_title, r.to_user_id, r.to_user_name, to_u.avatar as to_user_avatar, r.to_role_type, r.to_role_title, r.content, r.status, r.sort_num, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, r.del_flag from xfpt_comment_reply r left join sys_user from_u on r.from_user_id = from_u.user_id and from_u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user to_u on r.to_user_id = to_u.user_id and to_u.del_flag = '0' where r.comment_id = #{id} and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.sort_num asc, r.create_time asc, r.id asc
